podcast.title: Pioneering Electronic Music
podcast.body: The soundtrack for the 1960s "Doctor Who" series is recognized as one of the most important albums in electronic music history. It is credited with having laid the foundations for the electronic genre, preceding many works considered classical electronic music, and is highly recommended for its significant sounds and original compositional work. "uno de los álbumes que asentó las bases de la electrónica antes que mucha electrónica clásica que tenemos."
